<style>
body {
  font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 15px;
  background: white;
}

.logos {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;

  margin-bottom: 5px;
}

.peru {
  width: 55px;

}

.inia {

}

.titulo {

}

}

.codigo {

  padding: 7px;

  text-align: center;
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: bold;
}

.datos {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr;

}

.dato {

}

.dato .valor {
  color: #333;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: bold;
}

.funcion {
  grid-column: 1 / 4;
  border: 1px solid #7A1F1F;
  border-radius: 7px;
  padding: 9px;
  text-align: center;
  background: #FFF8F8;
}

.funcion .label {
  color: #7A1F1F;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: bold;
}

.funcion .valor {
  color: #333;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: bold;
}
</style>
